name: Kuramae
tagline: Tokyo in 13 minutes and Otemachi in 15 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000.
summary: The station is in Taito City, where the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 15 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 33 minutes to Shibuya and 25 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. The station stands 3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.3 m to 5.3 m, a difference of 4.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 8 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 7 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 14 clinics and 19 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 同愛記念病院, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京自動車連合健康保険組合柳橋病院, about 8 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Toei Oedo Line and Toei Asakusa Line. Both lines are run by the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. Toei Asakusa Line runs at 123%. Its busiest stretch is 本所吾妻橋→浅草, which this station is likewise not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥120,000 to ¥130,000, 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000, 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Tawaramachi is ahead on how easy the shopping is and quiet, but Kuramae is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 3 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Kuramae.

neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Kuramae.

People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair

noiseSources: The 首都高速6号向島線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
江戸通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 10 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 5 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The number of points that fall inside the projected inundation area is about average for a station in the 23 wards.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
